balls.text: full and outside off, Pollard slaps it through to deep cover but it's only a single
full toss on off stump, Bhajji looks midwicket again but misses. Appeal for leg before as he is hit full on the boot, but the ump says that was missing off.
length and outside off, Bhajji goes back and pulverises it over the midwicket boundary. That could rival Pollard's big ones
this time he goes over the off side and the decision proves fruitful. Full delivery lashed over extra cover.
sets up for another maul over midwicket, but the fuller ball beats him again. Pollard calls him up for a chat
slower delivery pushed across him, Bhajji looks to slog to cow corner and misses
here we go! This is up on the roof! It was overpitched outside off, Pollard plants his front foot down and massacres it straight over the top.
low full toss on the hips, Pollard accepts the offering with a whip that thuds into the fine leg boundary

he's lost grip of the bat while heaving at a fuller ball on middle and leg. Should only have been a single down to deep midwicket and calls a bewildered Gautam through for a non-existent double. Good throw from the deep sees Mumbai's top-scorer well short
fullish and outside off, Gautam drives to mid-off for a single
length from Shami, belted down the ground
full toss tailing in, Pollard's flick ends up as an outside edge into the covers. Instinctively looks for a single, but has to be sent back
back of a length and outside off, he was looking to help it over third man but doesn't connect
looks to drag it from well outside off, but gets a thick inside edge. It was short and angled well across him, Gautam goes for the pull and mistimes it
shortish and outside off, he looks to cut but is beaten
fullish and outside off, Gautam was deep in his crease and lofts it over the head of mid-off. Just has enough power in the stroke to reach the ropes
low full toss on off stump, Pollard slogs it to deep midwicket. But the more important detail is that Parnell has overstepped
full and wide outside off, Pollard looks to smack it over extra. Misses and he also loses control of the bat. Just bursts out of his grip and lands somewhere behind him
looks to heave it into the next town, but the pull shot is a little too soon in coming down on the slower ball
dropped by DK. It was the slower ball to which Gautam was skipping down to. Looked to steer it down to third man but got too fine an edge. He dives to his right but shells it

sets up for another reverse swat but this time Unadkat directs the slower ball down leg to prevent him from carrying through with the stroke. But it clips his thigh pad and sneaks off to deep fine leg
why is he batting so low down the order! It was fullish on middle, but Gautam has reverse flicked it to the third man boundary.
one-bounce four over extra! Uses his feet against Unadkat's slower ball and unleashes a full swing of the arms
full and angled in at him as Unadkat continues around to the right-handers, Pollard uses his wrists and it has enough power in it to almost carry to deep square leg
slower short ball, Gautam uses soft hands to drop it around point. Sees Pollard racing down the pitch and sets off for the single
gets under it and it sails into the stands beyond long-on. It was length and Pollard waded into it, a full swing of the bat and his inherent power made it a foregone conclusion
walks across and heaves the length ball to deep square leg
slower ball dupes him again. It was short of a good length and outside off, swings away and gets an inside edge to deep square leg
fullish and outside off, he skips down the track and slashes over point
short ball with a bit of room and it is the slower ball too, Gautam cuts over the cover field but there is protection in the deep
shuffles across to clip the back of a length delivery through midwicket. Struck a little too high on the pads, optimistic appeal
flighted on middle, he comes forward to block. Gets an inside edge towards midwicket
skips down the track and lifts him over the covers. Lovely footwork to reach the pitch and QDK helps him out with a lazy misfield on the boundary
skids onto him and he just barely makes contact to get a single. Arm ball rushes him
flighted just a bit outside off, he sweeps to deep square leg. Loads of effort for little result
flighted delivery, gets a bit of turn to take the outside edge towards point
good length ball on middle, he goes back and flicks through midwicket
fullish on off stump, steps forward to block
what a beauty! This is a loopy, slower yorker off the back of the hand. Huss had to wait ages and ages and ages but when he finally jams the bat down he misses and gets his off stump pegged
clipped calmly off his toes as Unadkat angles it full and straight
fires it in full on middle, Huss clips to deep midwicket
dabs the back of a length delivery towards point and races across for a single. Beats the throw, but just about
slower delivery bowled full and a shade outside off, Huss steers it behind point
he screams out in anger as he missed a full delivery tailing onto the pads. Shows how out of form he is, that was there to be whipped through midwicket.
belted down the ground as he got under the fuller ball outside off. Shukla leaps up to try and catch it but it was just struck too hard
just short of a good length, Pollard blocks

spears it in on middle and leg, Pollard almost falls over himself while looking to clip through midwicket. Gets struck quite low on the pads and the pitch map says it was hit in line and might have crashed into the stumps

wanders down the pitch to heave it over square leg. It was a length ball which nips in just a touch to beat the stroke and hit him on the back pad, but the appeal is useless as he was struck outside off
full on middle, Hussey pushes down the ground for a single
full delivery pushed to mid-off and he hares across to retain strike
and far too often he bowls that delivery. Too full and way down the leg side
short ball on middle, but the slower pace means he mistimes the pull. Gets an inside edge that goes nowhere
129kph, saw him dancing down and gives him notice with a well directed short one. Huss doesn't have any room to work with and ducks under it
wants a single, but Pollard sends him back. It was a fuller delivery on middle. He flicks a little too early and gets a leading edge into the covers. Just about makes his ground
gets a thick outside edge as he inches out of his crease. Parnell drags it short to not let him get under it. Push down the ground ends up at third man
pokes outside off with half and bat and he's beaten. Good length ball pushed across him. Polly looking out of touch
works it through square leg as he stays back to a delivery he probably could have come forward
pulls him forward with a tossed up delivery on off stump, defended
opens the blade and taps the shortish delivery towards backward point
flighted on middle, nudges to mid-on
goes deep in his crease and whips the length ball away to deep midwicket. That's MI's 50
flighted on middle, Huss opts for the reverse sweep but he can't get it beyond point
there's the tester. Makes Pollard jerk his head aside as the bouncer sails over middle. Good ball
picked away off his hips and pulls, albeit not well, to deep fine leg
turned away through square leg for a single
ventures down the track and nudges the back of a length delivery behind square leg
back of a length on off stump, Huss works towards midwicket
yep, but Hussey's pull is a little late. Gets struck on the body
picks out long-on! It was flighted on off stump and he steps out and decided to go for the big one. Heaves it over the top but connects off the toe. Simple catch
a little more round-arm this time as he comes down the track. Goes on with the arm and hits him on the pads while he goes for the flick
flighted on off stump, Huss pushes into the covers and short extra is not quick enough to stop the single
he was afraid of Rayudu coming down the track again. Drags it short and he slaps it through the covers
low full toss on leg stump, Huss clips to deep midwicket
skips down the track and pushes down to long-on
lovely line from JP. Tossed up on middle and it's defended calmly
flighted outside off, he eases it down to long-off
and loads of turn this time. Good length ball on middle and off and as Rayudu rocks back to cut, he's cramped for room and has to block
poor choice of shot and Rayudu is lucky his off stump is still intact. Flighted on off stump and he goes for the sweep. This went on with the arm to fool him
flightede outside off, Rayudu was looking to drive through the covers but ends up inside edging it
good length ball on off stump, defended
slower, shorter ball. Rayudu is wise to it and nudges behind square leg
back of a length and angled into him, clipped through square leg

rank long hop and Anderson has thumped it straight to deep midwicket! Unadkat raises his hands in triumph and Anderson is in disbelief. The pull was quite well timed, but like Tare he picked the only fielder there
walks at him and pushes the fuller delivery towards midwicket. Slower ball off the back of the hand makes him think twice
digs it into the middle of the pitch, but it is pulled comfortably to deep midwicket
tucks him up for room with a shortish delivery, Anderson nudges towards midwicket
fullish on off stump, perhaps straightening a touch. Rayudu comes forward and blocks
back of a length and outside off, Anderson is content with a single to point
one-bounce and clatters into the midwicket boundary. Shami's move to go around the wicket and dig it in short backfires as it sits up and Anderson cashes in with a thumping pull
shortish and outside off, pulled the pace off it. Anderson dabs into the covers
short ball on middle, Rayudu leaps up and nudges into the leg side. Anderson is quick to set off and pulls out a big dive to save himself from Shami's throw
more movement into the batsman and Rayudu manages an inside edge and the ball doesn't wander past his boots
tossed up outside off, Anderson is down on one-knee and sweeps along the ground to the square leg boundary. Smothered any turn on it and muscled it away
this turns off the deck and cramps Rayudu as he was trying to cut. Has to adjust and pushes to long-on
deep midwicket gets another work out as Duminy goes full and on the pads
flighted on middle, Rayudu comes forward to steers towards point
good footwork there from Rayudu! Just a shade short and he moved back and punched it in front of point.
tossed up onto the pads, works it through midwicket
fullish and just a shade outside off, Rayudu is forward and pushes down to mid-off
sees fine leg a little square and he's taken advantage of a fulller ball on leg stump. Flicked calmly to the boundary
back of a length and slid across the right-hander, Rayudu opens the face to point
pulls all the pace off this good length ball on middle and leg, Rayudu was deceived and gets struck on the thigh

deep midwicket steadies himself under it and takes it easily. It was short around the off stump, Tare shifted back and swung seeking to clear the boundary but QDK ran to his left and completes a straightforward take
fullish on middle, he gets it off the inside half of the bat to mid-on. Parnell searching for inswing.
shortish and down leg, terrible start
this time he's trapped in his crease but the good length ball would have skid down leg to foil that leg before appeal
comes down the track as he goes for the swipe down the ground. Duminy gets it to dip a little and he's struck on the back pad
a little too short and he sets up for the cut. Doesn't beat point
tossed up on leg, goes forward nudged to mid-on
backs away and punches into the covers. It was on a good length and came on with the arm
flighted on and around off stump, comes forward to block
just back of a length and outside off, dabbed towards point
it was short but Tare has no problem taking care of it. Pulls over the short fine leg fielder and he's got enough on it to reach the boundary
more seam into him and Rohit wants a quick single after dabbing it into leg. But Shami has seen an opportunity, darted across, picked up with one hand and aimed base of middle. Rohit was miles out.
on a good length on middle, Tare pushes down to mid-on
142kph, shortish on middle, Rohit gets a little bit of inside edge onto his thigh pad and they race through as the ball dribbles down the pitch
back of a length and darts in off the deck, Tare is late on his flick and settles for a leg bye towards point
goes back and whips it from outside off down to long-on. Nadeem continues with his flatter trajectory
pushed through on the pads, clipped to square leg
flighted on off stump to compensate and Rohit pushes down to long-off
drifting down leg and though his half-sweep and half-scoop misses
flighted on leg, Rohit eases it along the ground to deep midwicket
goes back and pushes through to deep midwicket. A little more flatter on middle
flighted on middle, Rohit nudges straight of midwicket

four to fine leg and that's the game in the bag. Walks across to off stump and clips the length ball with some class. Mumbai have crashed into their fourth loss in a row and those hand shakes and pats on the back would have negligible effect
fullish and outside off, he opens the face and steers it between cover and point
goes length now and Jadhav swings wildly, misses
another short ball and it's a good one too. KP's late on the hook and he gets a bit of a top edge that evades midwicket
dug in short and Jadhav's hook doesn't connect well. Ends up just behind square leg
offcutter ends up a full toss which is flicked to deep square leg
full toss outside off, KP flicks it down to long-on for a single
full on off stump, KP pushes to mid-off
seeks the yorker on middle and leg, KP glances it down to deep fine leg and though the fielder dived early, he is able to keep it to a couple
gets in a yorker on middle, jams it down the ground for a single
offcutter on off stump, KP clips to midwicket
Anderson makes good ground but it falls short of his big dive forward. KP mistimes a loft down the ground off a length delivery. Gets it off a thick inside edge
back of a length and outside off, he lets it come on and steers it to deep third man
a little room outside off and it's chopped towards point. Huss misfields but it doesn't prove costly
picked away off his legs. Walks across to the length ball and helps it on it's way. Mistake from Zak, capitalised. Hands on his hips time for the bowler
fires in full on off stump, he slices it with an open face towards the sweeper
back of a length and outside off, cut into the covers
yorker just outside off, he keeps it out

Mumbai dug-out and the fans have woken up! Rayudu at short midwicket has pulled off another important catch and Malinga magic seems inevitable. It was full on middle and he's just clipped it straight to the fielder
walks down and almost yorks himself as he looks to push through the off side. Gets a thick inside edge that evades leg stump
inswinging yorker ends up a low full toss and he clips between the two midwickets
caught in the covers! Slices a fuller ball with an open face and he picks out the fielder. Mumbai rejoice. Is this going to turn out into a low-scoring thriller too? Tune in after the time out
slower ball on leg stump, Duminy keeps it out
swipes towards square leg
goes back to the fuller delivery and opens the face to pick up a single in front of point
flighted on middle, he thumps it down the ground. Anderson races to his left from long-on and looked to slap it back inside the field but is unsuccessful
pushed through outside off and KP has slashed it through the covers. Waited on it just a touch and opened the face to make sure long-off had no chance
take that! Advances down the track and launches the length ball straight over the top.
goes back to the length ball and clips through to deep midwicket
goes back and taps it down to long-off
looped up on middle as he moves outside leg. Slices it through point. Struck uppishly but it lands safely
skips down the track and drives to long-on
pushed through outside off, stays back and chops it towards the sweeper
gets a bottom edge on the reverse sweep and they take a single to backward point
goes back to a good length ball and pushes back to the bowler
flighted on off stump, he moves forward and pushes to mid-on
tossed up on middle and leg, KP looks to paddle it around the corner but doesn't connect too well. Ends up getting a couple though since long leg was too deep
nudges the good length ball towards midwicket
gets him in a tangle straight away. It was pushed through on middle and KP covers his stumps and blocks
off stump knocked back as Vijay goes for an awful slog. Nothing particularly threatening about the delivery, the batsman just went for too optimistic a stroke. Underestimated Rohit, I suppose
flighted on off stump, pushed down the ground to long-off
flatter ball on off stump, JP punches to long-on
beaten by flight as Ojha pulls this back after seeing JP skipping down the track. Can;t connect with the flick
good length just outside off, Vijay pushes down to long-off
tossed up outside off and Vijay eases it over the covers. Stays beside the ball and drives confidently
flighted but it was in the slot and Vijay has slog swept it over the square leg boundary. Lovely hit
skips down the track and works the length ball away towards square leg
mid-off leaps up and sticks out his right hand, but Vijay's loft has beaten him. It was length and angled across him. Launched into the stroke and succeeds in getting it to the ropes
works the shortish delivery off his hips towards long leg
just back of a length and it is steered behind point
thumped down the ground. Vijay's good when he's hitting straight. It was an offcutter pushed quite full and he slices it powerfully
full on the legs, Duminy flicks away to deep square leg
length ball, picked away off the back foot to long-on
gets a lovely bit of bounce as he beats Duminy's poke towards point.
loopy doosra outside off, JP chops it behind point to collect a couple to the man in the deep
opens the face to tap the good length delivery angling in at him towards short third man
flighted outside off but JP lunges forward and laps it to short fine leg
flighted just outside off, Vijay was backing away and dabs it through cover point
a tad short and he rocks back to punch it to deep point
whips off his knees for a couple to deep square leg and that will be the time out
a little bit of turn and Vijay has to open the face of his bat as he pushes to point
flighted on off stump, kept out
comes down the track to nudge it straight of midwicket, but Rohit cuts across and keeps it to one with a sprawling dive
stays back to punch the good length ball to mid-off
tossed up on middle, Vijay flicks to long-on
clipped away through midwicket to retain strike
the doosra ends up a little too short and Vijay went deep in his crease and chopped it behind point. Rayudu was the sweeper but he had too much work to do
skips down the track and works it down to mid-on
tossed up outside off, JP drills it through the covers and picks up a well-run couple
loopy delivery on off stump, JP steps forward to block
pushed through on the pads, Vijay clips behind square leg
fullish and outside off, JP gets a thick inside edge to mid-on to get off the mark. Pollard takes aim at the keeper's end and gives away an overthrow
what a ripper from Hussey at point! It was cut pretty well and he had to dive full length and low to his left. Holds on with two hands and QDK has to walk back.

QDK is too eager and he would have been well short of his ground had Rohit thrown the stumps down direct from short cover. There was no single there after Vijay pushed forward and nudged into the off side, but the overthrow gives the single in the end
full and outside off, drives it wide of mid-off for a single
fullish and outside off, Vijay pushes it down to mid-off and it would have been a tight single, only Zak underarms the throw
back of a length, steered towards backward point
backs away and looks to cut past point, but the flatter delivery follows him and he can't find the gap
goes on with the arm this time and De Kock's cut shot is horribly mistimed
goes for a wild sweep, but this skids off the deck and beats him comprehensively
flighted just outside off, he taps it into the covers
nowhere near short enough to pull, plus it was angled into him to cramp him up. Vijay gets struck on the thigh pad and picks up a single behind point
stays back and punches the good length ball back at the bowler. QDK who was backing up had to dive back into his ground
fullish and on off stump, De Kock drills it to cover
chops the slower delivery off the inside edge but Mumbai are not lucky enough for it to knock over the stumps
yorker on off stump, De Kock presents an open face to push it into the covers
the third slower ball of the over and De Kock is right behind it
another slower ball, full on off stump. Inches forward and blocks with soft hands

that's a rare sight! Aside from the ball wandering away from the keeper's gloves and hitting the helmet, it was a yorker gone way down leg from Malinga. Five penalty runs then, in addition to the wide
offcutter just outside off, De Kock waits on it and plays with soft hands towards point
flighted on middle, Vijay keeps it out
stays beside the ball and drills this along the ground and long-off has a lot of running to do. Pollard is the man who raced across and kicked it back in the field of play
goes for the sweep this time and since he was playing against the turn, he misses it
backs away and lifts the dart into the pads over the covers. A little quicker than the last ball and he used it to calmly send it packing
teases him with a slower, flighted delivery outside off, De Kock was lured into an expansive drive through the covers and is beaten
doesn't offer much flight and Vijay pushes down towards long-on
stays beside the fuller delivery outside off and drives into the covers
this good length ball seems to have held up on the pitch a little more. Vijay was early on the flick and it lobs up in the air but lands quite safely in front of midwicket
drives to mid-off as he comes forward to the fuller delivery on the stumps
fullish and outside off, Vijay steps forward and blocks towards point
shortish and outside off, De Kock taps it into the covers. Rayudu displays some ordinary skills to give away the single
goes full on off stump, De Kock jams it down to mid-off
flighted on middle but Vijay again moves beside the ball but this time he nudges into the covers
flighted on off stump, De Kock pushes down the ground for a single
a little turn away from the bat as he holds his length back, Vijay taps it behind point
this time he runs down the wicket and unleashes a terrible slog. Gets an inside edge onto his pads
fired in on middle, Vijay blocks down the pitch
inches away outside leg and eases the flighted delivery over extra cover. Lovely shot
flicked past a diving square leg. Strays in line and De Kock treats himself to a nice, compact looking flick and his timing is very good
tails away late and Vijay gets a thick outside edge on the yorker to get off the mark with a single to deep third man
another of his productive variations. It's the offcutter on off stump, Vijay can only block
jams his bat down on an almost yorker outside off, gets a single to the right of mid-off
generates some late inward movement again but QDK is good enough to present a dead bat
curls in off a fuller length on middle, De Kock pushes down to mid-on
